name: shipwright
description: Shipwright is a browser-based collaborative editing environment for building spaceship models rendered in Three.js, where an LLM and a human author can build spaceship models in the style of classic games like [X-Wing](<https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars:_X-Wing_(video_game)>), [TIE Fighter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars:_TIE_Fighter) or [Wing Commander](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wing_Commander_III:_Heart_of_the_Tiger).
author: Kevin Whinnery
